14	// Watch monitors the config file for changes and emits validated *Config values
15	// on the returned channel. The channel is closed when ctx is cancelled.
16	// Invalid configs are logged and discarded; the running config is never replaced
17	// with a broken one.
18	//
19	// The watcher targets the directory containing the config file so that
20	// editor write-rename patterns (vim, sed -i) are detected correctly — they
21	// delete the inode, which breaks file-level watches.
22	func Watch(ctx context.Context, log *slog.Logger) (<-chan *Config, error) {
23		path := Path()
24		dir := filepath.Dir(path)
25		base := filepath.Base(path)
26	
27		watcher, err := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
28		if err != nil {
29			return nil, err
30		}
31		if err := watcher.Add(dir); err != nil {
32			watcher.Close()
33			return nil, err
34		}
35	
36		ch := make(chan *Config, 1)
37	
38		go func() {
39			defer close(ch)
40			defer watcher.Close()
41	
42			var timer *time.Timer
43			var timerC <-chan time.Time
44	
45			for {
46				select {
47				case <-ctx.Done():
48					if timer != nil {
49						timer.Stop()
50					}
51					return
52	
53				case event, ok := <-watcher.Events:
54					if !ok {
55						return
56					}
57					if filepath.Base(event.Name) != base {
58						continue
59					}
60					if timer != nil {
61						timer.Stop()
62					}
63					timer = time.NewTimer(debounceDuration)
64					timerC = timer.C
65	
66				case <-timerC:
67					timerC = nil
68					timer = nil
69					cfg, err := Load()
70					if err != nil {
71						log.Error("config reload failed", "err", err)
72						continue
73					}
74					select {
75					case ch <- cfg:
76					default:
77						log.Warn("config channel full, dropping reload")
78					}
79	
80				case err, ok := <-watcher.Errors:
81					if !ok {
82						return
83					}
84					log.Error("fsnotify error", "err", err)
85				}
86			}
87		}()
88	
89		return ch, nil
90	}

107	func (m *Manager) Snapshot() []monitor.BackendStatus {
108		m.mu.RLock()
109		defer m.mu.RUnlock()
110	
111		result := make([]monitor.BackendStatus, 0, len(m.procs))
112		for _, ps := range m.procs {

124				Status:    ps.state.String(),

126				Restarts:  ps.restarts,

191		modelCtx, modelCancel := context.WithCancel(m.ctx)
192		ps := &procState{
193			modelName: modelName,
194			params:    params,
195			state:     stateLoading,
196			ready:     make(chan struct{}),
197			cancel:    modelCancel,
198			isWarmup:  isWarmup,
199		}

201		m.mu.Lock()
202		m.procs[modelName] = ps
203		m.mu.Unlock()

205		m.wg.Add(1)
206		ps.wg.Add(1)
207		go m.supervise(modelCtx, modelName)

211	// Reload applies newCfg to the running manager. Models whose params changed are
212	// drained and restarted; models no longer matching any pattern are drained and
213	// removed; new warmup entries are started. Models with unchanged params keep
214	// serving without interruption.
215	//
216	// Global fields that require a process restart (e.g. listen address) are logged
217	// as warnings but not applied.
218	func (m *Manager) Reload(newCfg *config.Config) {
219		if m.cfg.Listen != newCfg.Listen {
220			m.log.Warn("listen address changed; requires restart to take effect",
221				"old", m.cfg.Listen, "new", newCfg.Listen)
222		}
223	
224		type drainOp struct {
225			name      string
226			ps        *procState
227			newParams config.ModelParams
228			restart   bool
229			isWarmup  bool
230		}
231	
232		newWarmupSet := make(map[string]bool, len(newCfg.Warmup))
233		for _, name := range newCfg.Warmup {
234			newWarmupSet[name] = true
235		}
236	
237		m.mu.Lock()
238		m.cfg = newCfg
239	
240		var ops []drainOp
241		for name, ps := range m.procs {
242			ps.mu.Lock()
243			state := ps.state
244			oldParams := ps.params
245			wasWarmup := ps.isWarmup
246			ps.mu.Unlock()
247	
248			if state != stateLoaded && state != stateLoading {
249				continue
250			}
251	
252			newParams, ok := newCfg.MatchModel(name)
253			if !ok {
254				m.log.Info("draining removed model", "model", name)
255				ps.mu.Lock()
256				ps.state = stateUnloading
257				ps.mu.Unlock()
258				ops = append(ops, drainOp{name: name, ps: ps})
259				continue
260			}
261	
262			if !oldParams.Equal(newParams) {
263				m.log.Info("reloading model", "model", name)
264				ps.mu.Lock()
265				ps.state = stateUnloading
266				ps.mu.Unlock()
267				ops = append(ops, drainOp{
268					name:      name,
269					ps:        ps,
270					newParams: newParams,
271					restart:   true,
272					isWarmup:  wasWarmup || newWarmupSet[name],
273				})
274				continue
275			}
276	
277			if wasWarmup && !newWarmupSet[name] {
278				m.log.Info("draining removed warmup model", "model", name)
279				ps.mu.Lock()
280				ps.state = stateUnloading
281				ps.mu.Unlock()
282				ops = append(ops, drainOp{name: name, ps: ps})
283			}
284		}

288		// This runs outside m.mu to avoid deadlocking with the supervisor goroutine.
289		for i := range ops {

292		for i := range ops {
293			ops[i].ps.wg.Wait()
294		}

296		m.mu.Lock()
297		for i := range ops {

299		}
300		m.mu.Unlock()

303		for _, op := range ops {

307				}

309		}

312		for _, name := range newCfg.Warmup {

368	// LoadOrGet returns the address of the named model, loading it on demand if
369	// necessary. Concurrent calls for the same unloaded model coalesce — one
370	// process starts and all waiters get the address when it becomes healthy.
371	//
372	// The caller must call the returned release function (typically via defer) when
373	// the proxied request completes. This decrements the in-flight counter and
374	// allows the model to be evicted once idle.
375	//
376	// Errors:
377	//   - context.Canceled / context.DeadlineExceeded: caller's context expired
378	//   - "model is shutting down": model is being drained
379	//   - "at capacity …": max_models reached with all models in use
380	//   - "model … load failed: …": llama-server failed to start or become healthy
381	func (m *Manager) LoadOrGet(ctx context.Context, modelName string, params config.ModelParams) (addr string, release func(), err error) {
382		noop := func() {}
383	
384		m.mu.Lock()
385	
386		if ps, ok := m.procs[modelName]; ok {
387			ps.mu.Lock()
388			state := ps.state
389			ready := ps.ready
390			port := ps.port
391			ps.mu.Unlock()
392	
393			switch state {
394			case stateLoaded:
395				ps.inflight.Add(1)
396				ps.mu.Lock()
397				ps.lastUsed = time.Now()
398				ps.mu.Unlock()
399				m.mu.Unlock()
400				return fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", port), func() { ps.inflight.Add(-1) }, nil
401	
402			case stateLoading:
403				// Another goroutine is already loading this model. Wait for it.
404				m.mu.Unlock()
405				select {
406				case <-ready:
407				case <-ctx.Done():
408					return "", noop, ctx.Err()
409				}
410				return m.checkLoaded(modelName)
411	
412			case stateUnloading:
413				m.mu.Unlock()
414				return "", noop, fmt.Errorf("model %q is shutting down", modelName)
415	
416			case stateIdle:
417				// Stale failed entry; clean up and reload.
418				delete(m.procs, modelName)
419			}
420		}
421	
422		// Model not present (or was idle): check capacity, evict if needed, then load.
423		// evictIfNeeded may release and re-acquire m.mu internally.
424		if err := m.evictIfNeeded(); err != nil {
425			m.mu.Unlock()
426			return "", noop, err
427		}
428	
429		// Re-check: another goroutine may have loaded this model while we evicted.
430		if ps2, ok := m.procs[modelName]; ok {
431			ps2.mu.Lock()
432			state2 := ps2.state
433			ready2 := ps2.ready
434			port2 := ps2.port
435			ps2.mu.Unlock()
436			switch state2 {
437			case stateLoaded:
438				ps2.inflight.Add(1)
439				ps2.mu.Lock()
440				ps2.lastUsed = time.Now()
441				ps2.mu.Unlock()
442				m.mu.Unlock()
443				return fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", port2), func() { ps2.inflight.Add(-1) }, nil
444			case stateLoading:
445				m.mu.Unlock()
446				select {
447				case <-ready2:
448				case <-ctx.Done():
449					return "", noop, ctx.Err()
450				}
451				return m.checkLoaded(modelName)
452			}
453		}
454	
455		// Create a new procState and start the supervisor.
456		modelCtx, modelCancel := context.WithCancel(m.ctx)
457		ps := &procState{
458			modelName: modelName,
459			params:    params,
460			state:     stateLoading,
461			ready:     make(chan struct{}),
462			cancel:    modelCancel,
463			isWarmup:  false,
464		}
465		m.procs[modelName] = ps
466		ready := ps.ready
467		m.mu.Unlock()
468	
469		m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
470			Time:    time.Now(),
471			Backend: modelName,
472			Kind:    monitor.EventModelLoad,
473			Message: "loading on demand",
474		})
475	
476		m.wg.Add(1)
477		ps.wg.Add(1)
478		go m.supervise(modelCtx, modelName)
479	
480		select {
481		case <-ready:
482		case <-ctx.Done():
483			return "", noop, ctx.Err()
484		}
485	
486		return m.checkLoaded(modelName)
487	}

491		noop := func() {}
492	
493		m.mu.RLock()
494		ps, ok := m.procs[modelName]
495		m.mu.RUnlock()
496	
497		if !ok {
498			return "", noop, fmt.Errorf("model %q load failed", modelName)
499		}

501		ps.mu.Lock()
502		state := ps.state
503		loadErr := ps.loadErr
504		port := ps.port
505		ps.mu.Unlock()

507		if state != stateLoaded {
508			if loadErr != nil {
509				return "", noop, fmt.Errorf("model %q load failed: %w", modelName, loadErr)
510			}
511			return "", noop, fmt.Errorf("model %q load failed", modelName)
512		}

515		ps.mu.Lock()

521	// evictIfNeeded evicts the LRU idle healthy model if we are at capacity.
522	//
523	// IMPORTANT: must be called with m.mu write-locked. It temporarily releases
524	// and re-acquires m.mu while waiting for the evicted supervisor to exit,
525	// so the caller must re-validate procs state after it returns.
526	func (m *Manager) evictIfNeeded() error {
527		// Count non-idle models.
528		running := 0
529		for _, ps := range m.procs {
530			ps.mu.Lock()
531			s := ps.state
532			ps.mu.Unlock()
533			if s != stateIdle {
534				running++
535			}
536		}
537		if running < m.cfg.MaxModels {
538			return nil
539		}
540	
541		// Find LRU healthy model with no in-flight requests.
542		type candidate struct {
543			name     string
544			ps       *procState
545			lastUsed time.Time
546		}
547		var candidates []candidate
548		for name, ps := range m.procs {
549			ps.mu.Lock()
550			state := ps.state
551			lu := ps.lastUsed
552			ps.mu.Unlock()
553			if state == stateLoaded && ps.inflight.Load() == 0 {
554				candidates = append(candidates, candidate{name: name, ps: ps, lastUsed: lu})
555			}
556		}
557		if len(candidates) == 0 {
558			return fmt.Errorf("at capacity (%d/%d models); all models have in-flight requests", running, m.cfg.MaxModels)
559		}
560	
561		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
562			return candidates[i].lastUsed.Before(candidates[j].lastUsed)
563		})
564	
565		victim := candidates[0]
566		victim.ps.mu.Lock()
567		victim.ps.state = stateUnloading
568		victim.ps.mu.Unlock()
569	
570		// Release the manager lock while waiting for the supervisor to exit.
571		m.mu.Unlock()
572	
573		m.log.Info("evicting model (LRU)", "model", victim.name)
574		m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
575			Time:    time.Now(),
576			Backend: victim.name,
577			Kind:    monitor.EventModelLoad,
578			Message: "unloading (LRU eviction)",
579		})
580	
581		victim.ps.cancel()  // SIGTERM via context cancellation
582		victim.ps.wg.Wait() // wait for supervisor goroutine to exit
583	
584		m.mu.Lock() // re-acquire for the caller
585		delete(m.procs, victim.name)
586		return nil
